options.text: The message is small for a small poke and big for a big one, like turning a volume knob.
Below the gate's opening voltage, nothing travels. Above it, a full-sized wave runs the whole length, the same size whatever the poke.
Any poke sends a full wave.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Touch it and it fires."

image.alt: A nerve cable receiving a small poke and a bigger poke at one end, small gates in the wall not yet responding.
